descriptor: Everyday banking with neatly stacked cards

voice.summary: Pocketbank sounds like a helpful friend who is good with money and never makes you feel small about it. Copy is short, uses everyday words, and keeps the numbers masked until you ask to see them.
dos: Use everyday words: freeze, spend, top up
Keep figures masked by default and say so
Confirm security actions in one reassuring line
donts: Do not use banking jargon like 'facilitate' or 'remittance'
Never show a full card number without a clear tap

taglines: All your cards, one tidy pile
Money you can find at a glance
boilerplate: Pocketbank is a mobile banking app that keeps debit, savings, travel and business cards in one tidy stack, with instant freeze and clear spending history.

microcopy.error: Could not freeze this card. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No recent spending on this card.

logo.note: Stacked coins hint at both the money and the layered card stack at the heart of the app.
